'''Kane''', also known as '''Steel Claw''', was a [[Nikto]] [[racer]] who participated in [[Riot Racing]] on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> Kane worked with another racer [[Jet Venim]] to grab hold of opponents who threaten Venim's chance on winning.<ref name="Faster" /><ref name="Databank" />

In order to guarantee Venim's number one spot, he deployed his eponymous gadget which violently yanked the second place out of the running entirely. This maneuver was called "The Crunch".<ref name="Databank" />
